subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II + targeted control artifacts (MFA, privileged access, auth logs)
messages:
From: Claire Boudreaux <claire.boudreaux@veritas-audit.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Security <secops@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II + targeted control artifacts (MFA, privileged access, auth logs)

Mina,

Following up on Acme Health's vendor intake — Veritas is running the SOC 2 Type II readiness review on behalf of their InfoSec team. We reviewed the public listing, and to complete our control testing we need the most recent SOC 2 Type II report plus a few targeted artifacts tied to the auth/authz controls:

- SOC 2 Type II report covering the period ending 2024-10-31 (PDF)
- Bridge letter confirming no significant control changes since the report date
- MFA enrollment snapshot for the audit period (CSV): user id, enrollment status, method, enrollment date
- Privileged account inventory and justification mapping (CSV)
- AuthN/authZ log slices (application and console) for representative days within the audit window — preferably a 7-day slice; we only need successful & failed auth events and privilege elevation actions

A couple of notes: we require minimal PII in artifacts; please redact or replace full customer emails if present. For logs, hashed identifiers or truncated IPs are fine. Deliver via secure transfer (ShareFile or presigned S3 URL) and include checksums.

Target delivery: July 18, 2027. If you have a preferred subset or want to propose an extract window, let me know. Also confirm the exact audit period you assert the SOC report covers so we can align our sampling.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Boudreaux
Senior IT Auditor | Veritas Advisory
claire.boudreaux@veritas-audit.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

--
Forwarding guidance: when possible attach a bridge letter that explicitly states: (1) report period, (2) any material control changes since the report, (3) point of contact for evidence questions.
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Claire Boudreaux <claire.boudreaux@veritas-audit.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + targeted control artifacts (MFA, privileged access, auth logs)

Claire —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report and a tailored set of artifacts. Quick clarifications so we meet your scope exactly:

1) Audit period: Our latest Type II report covers 2024-11-01 through 2025-10-31. Can you confirm that aligns with your sampling needs?
2) For "7-day slice" — would you prefer a continuous calendar week or representative days across the period? We can produce either: a contiguous 7-day extract (recommended for event sequence verification) or three representative single-day slices spanning the period.
3) Redaction: we will redact customer PII and can supply a data dictionary documenting what was redacted. Is hashed user ids acceptable?

Attached for your review: a short MFA enrollment sample (MFA-enrollment-sample.csv) and a one-page bridge-letter draft we propose to finalize after your comments.

If that looks good we'll: (a) generate the privileged-account inventory and 7-day authn slice, (b) route the SOC report and signed bridge letter through our legal team, and (c) share via secure ShareFile link. Aim to have everything to you by July 18. If you need accelerated delivery on a subset (e.g., MFA + privileged-inventory only) tell us and we'll prioritize.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Compliance | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0199

Attachments: MFA-enrollment-sample.csv (stub), Bridge-letter-2024Q3-draft.docx (stub)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 10:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + targeted control artifacts (MFA, privileged access, auth logs)

Mina / Marissa —

Plan and owners:
- SOC 2 report + signed bridge letter: Legal (Marissa) will finalize the bridge letter; I'll pull the final PDF for transfer.
- MFA enrollment export: I'll run the auth service export for the audit window and produce MFA-enrollment-2024Q3.csv. Will include enrollment method and enrollment date.
- Privileged account inventory: I will query the identity catalog and output Privileged-account-inventory-2024Q3.csv; we'll include role mapping and justification comments from the owners.
- AuthN log slice: infra will generate the 7-day application + console authn slice (Authn-log-slice-2024-06-15_to_2024-06-21.jsonl). Note: logs include IPv4 and hashed user identifiers by default. Confirm whether you need IP truncation (e.g., 10.1.x.x) or full hashing.

Estimated times: MFA & privileged inventory by EOD Tue (2027-07-13), log slice by Wed (2027-07-14), SOC report + bridge by Fri (2027-07-16). That meets the July 18 target.

Security/transfer: we'll put artifacts on a protected ShareFile folder and send a short-lived download URL with SHA256 checksums. If Veritas prefers a direct S3 presigned approach, ping me and we'll do that.

Ticket for tracking: COMPLIANCE-3241 (will attach artifact checklist in the ticket).

Karthik
Director, Infrastructure Security | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Appended below is our internal plan and timeline. Short answers to your earlier questions:

- Slice preference: we recommend a contiguous 7-day window for sequence analysis; we propose June 15–21, 2024 as a representative week. If you want representative days instead, let us know.
- Redaction: hashed user ids and truncated IPs are fine; we will not include clear-text customer emails.

- SOC2-TypeII-2024Q3.pdf (stub)
